findings.reason: naming `reckon/file_memo.py` as the owner and extending it removes a duplicate parse cache the plan currently introduces silently.
findings.text: `parse_meta_shared` forks a second per-file parse memo (`_META_BY_DIGEST`, line 110) with its own 50 000-entry bound and `clear()`, beside the memo that already owns this job: `reckon/file_memo.memoized` (`reckon/file_memo.py:43`), used by `_plan_html.parse_meta` (`reckon/_plan_html.py:1561`). Two caches key the same parse and only one is dropped by the other's invalidation; the plan's §3 text never mentions this second cache at all. The content-digest-vs-path distinction is a real need, so the honest change is a signature-source parameter on `file_memo.memoized`, not a parallel cache.

findings.reason: §6 should extend `reckon/figures.py` with the thumbnail renderer or state in its own text why the figure owner cannot host it.
findings.text: §6 places `_render_thumbnail`/`_thumbnail_bytes` in `serve.py`, the file that already carries the endpoint and cache-key plumbing, rather than in `reckon/figures.py`, the module whose docstring states it owns figure discovery and dimensions (and which deliberately reads PNG/SVG/GIF dimensions without an imaging dependency). §6 justifies the Pillow dependency but not why figure inspection is split across two modules.

findings.reason: the section must account for the public surface it adds in its own text, per the interface budget rule.
findings.text: §3 adds a new module (`reckon/metadata_index.py`, ~9 public functions plus `IndexBuild`/`ROW_FIELDS`) and a new `/_index` route without naming anything §2 to §6 retires or merges, or stating why nothing can be; the pre-existing `/_discover` payload path and its in-process discovery cache survive unchanged beside it. §6 likewise adds a route and an imaging dependency with no retirement named.

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — `reckon/metadata_index.py` hides the persisted store, the row shape, the stat/digest keying and the rebuild/diff behind `index_rows`/`build_index`/`plan_derivations`, a small interface over substantial behaviour.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — `reckon/metadata_index.py` adds a second in-process parse cache (`_META_BY_DIGEST`) beside the per-file memo that owns it, `reckon/file_memo.memoized` used by `_plan_html.parse_meta`; and §6 puts thumbnail rendering in `reckon/serve.py` rather than in the module that owns figure inspection, `reckon/figures.py`.
rubric_items.interface_budget: a finding — public_definitions 1470, cli_options 317, mcp_views 33, refusal_families 23; §3 adds a new module's public surface and a new route, and §6 adds a route and an imaging dependency, and neither section names anything it retires or merges, or states why nothing can be.
rubric_items.reuse_search: pass — the plan names the mechanisms it extends (`_parse_meta_uncached`/`parse_meta`, the discovery cache, the git-history memo, `_write_project_event`, `discover_plans`) and builds explicitly on the landed `a-page-load-reads-each-file-once` repair; §3's landed module reuses `reckon/file_memo.file_signature`, `_plan_html` and `figures`.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — the new `/_index` route and the §4 loader merge are splits of one payload for a stated reason (paint before derived), not thin layers over machinery the plan declined to extend; §8 calls `metadata_index.index_rows` directly rather than wrapping it.
